response.generalSituation: A fresh to strong northeast monsoon will affect the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. A cold front is expected to move across the coast of southern China at first on Monday. Under the influence of the associated intense northeast monsoon, winds will strengthen from the north and temperatures will fall appreciably over the region. The weather will be generally fine and very dry over Guangdong midweek next week. It will be cool in the morning. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. Upper-air disturbances are expected to bring showers to southern China in the latter part of next week.
